about: Visual Musical Minds colours for Xylophone Basics. 'fla' = read from the user's Animate files (DEGA, The Everything File, Counter); 'derived' = never drawn in any .fla (no C or B plank, no C/F/B notehead), made by the same rules — change freely.

rules.bar: the plank's colour layer: unlit = 'barUnlit' (else 'bar') at 'barAlpha' (0.588; E 1, C and A 0.8) over the wood, lit = 'barLit' at 1
rules.barLetter: Myriad Pro Bold on the plank: unlit = barLetter, lit = white
rules.note: notehead + stem (+ beam end): unlit = note, lit = noteLit
rules.noteLetter: Baloo Thambi 2 SemiBold in the head: unlit = noteLetter, lit = white
rules.line: a staff line in its note's colour
rules.tracker: the side tracker, bottom up, one per example

C.source: derived (tracker red); unlit bright red at 0.8, the user's pick 2026-10-17 (at 0.588 it read like the D)

F.source: bar from The Everything File; the rest derived

A.source: fla; unlit = the A note's blue at 0.8, the user's pick 2026-10-17 (at 0.588 the deep blue read purple)
